description: This Java class provides implementation for the CodeWritePlatformService interface, managing creation, update, and deletion of 'Code' entities with database interactions, exception handling, and caching annotations.

classes.name: CodeWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service handling CRUD operations for Code entities with database interaction, validation, and exception handling.

methods.name: createCode
methods.description: Creates a new Code entity based on JSON command, saves it in the repository, and handles potential data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateCode
methods.description: Updates an existing Code entity with new data from JSON command, persists changes, and handles potential data integrity issues.

methods.name: deleteCode
methods.description: Deletes a Code entity if it is not system-defined, handles data integrity issues during deletion.

methods.name: retrieveCodeBy
methods.description: Retrieves Code entity by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: handleCodeDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions, mapping specific messages to domain exceptions.
